item.title: Trainee QA developer (internship)
item.description:
Space Scutum is a leading company in the field of cybersecurity and antivirus software development. We invite students and graduates to intern with our company to provide them with a unique opportunity to gain practical experience in the innovative field of cybersecurity. This is a social project for newcomers/students aimed at providing them with the opportunity to gain important practical experience, which will serve as a catalyst for their future career in the IT industry. Preference is given to students/trainees from Ukraine.

 

During the internship, you will work closely with our highly skilled team of specialists, participate in real projects, and learn cutting-edge technologies in the field of cybersecurity. We will provide you with the opportunity to apply your knowledge in practice, develop skills, and gain valuable experience that will be useful for your future career.

 

Upon completion of the internship, we have the opportunity to offer employment to the most talented interns or we are ready to provide recommendations for finding work in other companies. We believe that an internship at Space Scutum will be an excellent start to your career in the IT industry and help you achieve success in this dynamic and promising field.

We are excited to welcome interns to our dynamic software testing team. As we seek passionate individuals to join us in shaping the quality of our software, we have outlined the following requirements for prospective interns:

 

Analytical Skills:

Ability to analyze software and identify potential issues.

Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot and debug applications.

Attention to Detail:

Thoroughness and attention to detail in executing test cases and documenting results.

Communication Skills:

Clear and concise communication to effectively report bugs and issues.

Collaborative communication with team members and developers.

Curiosity and Learning Agility:

Eagerness to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving testing methodologies.

Proactive approach to staying informed about industry trends and best practices.

Team Collaboration:

Ability to work well in a team environment and contribute positively to team dynamics.

Willingness to seek guidance and ask questions when needed.

Time Management:

Efficient time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.

Adaptability:

Flexibility to adapt to changing project requirements and priorities.

Test Planning and Execution:

Understanding of test planning and execution processes.

Capability to design and execute test cases based on project requirements.

Documentation Skills:

Proficient in documenting test cases, test results, and test procedures.

Automation Familiarity (Optional):

Basic understanding of automated testing tools is a plus.

Passion for Quality:

A genuine interest in ensuring software quality and user satisfaction.

Professionalism:

Professional attitude and commitment to delivering high-quality work.

 

Join us and become a part of our team where you can unleash your potential, gain valuable experience, and contribute to ensuring user security.

 

If you are interested in this offer, please respond to this vacancy. Write about why you want to work with us. And what knowledge/skills do you have.

 

Thank you!

https://spacescutum.com/

item.title: Trainee/Junior Manual QA Engineer
item.description:
🔎About SoftPlus Ukraine

SoftPlus Ukraine is a growing software development company with roots in Ukraine and partnerships around the globe. We collaborate with companies of all sizes and stages — from ambitious startups to established enterprises. What unites our team is a shared passion for technology, a commitment to quality, and a drive to keep improving every day.

 

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We’re a diverse team of skilled professionals working remotely across different cities and countries, yet closely connected through teamwork, knowledge-sharing, and mutual support.

 

📌The Role

We’re looking for a Trainee/Junior Manual QA Engineer to join our team and contribute to building reliable, high-quality applications. Most of our projects are developed with Angular, .NET Core (EF Core), and MS SQL, giving you the chance to work with modern, in-demand technologies.

 

As part of the QA team, you’ll collaborate with developers, gain hands-on experience in testing, and grow your skills in a supportive environment where learning and improvement are encouraged.

 

📋Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the development team to define and maintain test cases and test plans
  • Execute manual and automated tests to ensure software quality and reliability
  • Monitor, identify, and troubleshoot issues during the deployment process
  • Contribute to the optimization of testing workflows and deployment practices
  • Stay up to date with emerging technologies, tools, and best practices in QA and DevOps

 

📝Requirements:

  • Completed or ongoing Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field﻿
  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, techniques, and tools
  • Practical experience with browser DevTools and SQL
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher
  • Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Availability for a full-time schedule: 12:00 – 20:30 (Mon–Fri, including a 30-minute lunch break)
  • Willingness to participate in regular team meetings during working hours
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities

 

✅Would Be a Plus:

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks
  • Working knowledge of Linux environments and scripting languages (e.g., Bash, Python)
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and containerization technologies (e.g., Docker)

 

﻿﻿What We Offer﻿

💸  Paid probation period — 4 weeks of full-time, hands-on experience before official hiring﻿

📈  Growth opportunities — clear paths for professional development and career advancement﻿

🔋 Supportive culture — a friendly, collaborative environment where your ideas matter﻿﻿

🖥️  Modern projects — work with cutting-edge technologies on meaningful, real-world applications﻿

💡 Talented team — join a motivated group of professionals who are always ready to share knowledge and help you grow

 

Join our team at SoftPlus Ukraine and contribute to the success of our innovative projects. 
Apply now!

item.title: QA Engineer
item.description:
Ukraine-based role

 

We’re looking for a proactive Junior QA with a problem-solving mindset and good English skills to join our Stormotion team.

 

Stormotion is a React Native-focused agency. We build mobile products in IoT/BLE, EV & Mobility, Fitness, and HealthTech/Mental Wellbeing for clients from the USA, Europe, and Australia. Small teams, direct client communication.

 

Requirements

  • Up to 2 years of QA experience
  • Good understanding of software testing fundamentals, including testing types, levels, and test design techniques;
  • Understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile methodologies;
  • Basic knowledge of mobile application testing principles and experience testing Android and iOS applications;
  • Ability to analyze requirements, identify potential risks, and investigate issues to determine their root causes;
  • Experience creating and executing test cases, checklists, and test scenarios;
  • Understanding of functional, regression, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing;
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar bug-tracking and task-management tools;
  • Basic understanding of client-server architecture;
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application in QA activities;
  • Basic understanding of accessibility, localization, and usability testing;
  • Good analytical thinking, attention to detail, and communication skills;
  • Spoken English Intermediate+: confident on calls, not only in chat

 

What you'll be working on:

  • Develop and constantly improve test cases and checklists for manual testing.
  • Perform manual testing (smoke/feature/regression/etc.) and prepare test reports (mostly for mobile projects).
  • Generate bug reports, categorize issues by priority/severity, track bugs’ lifecycle, and verify fixes.
  • Investigate user reports and customer requests.
  • Participate in projects’ scrum ceremonies: sprint planning, daily standups, demos, and retrospectives.

 

Will be a plus

  • Familiarity with mobile debugging tools, such as Android Studio, Logcat, Xcode Console, or similar;
  • Understanding of web application testing principles and experience with browser developer tools;
  • Passion for self-education in QA (professional books, thematic courses, pet-projects)

 

What we offer:

  • Healthy community where every person and their ideas matter;
  • Supportive environment of professionals that value quality above quantity;
  • 24 paid vacation days (21 + 3 Ukrainian public holidays) and 10 paid recharge days;
  • Donor Day-off and Birthday holiday;
  • Flexible working hours with the opportunity to work from your Ukraine-based home office;
  • Professional study compensation (courses/meetups/webinars)
  • Sport & Streamings budgets
  • Assistance with taxation PE documentation
